subject.title: feat: add Messages Name & Photo sharing

question: Should imsg adopt `name-photo` and the compatible `contacts.*` RPC methods as a supported public contract over this undocumented force-send selector once live proof is supplied?
rationale: Tests can verify guards and request construction, but only maintainers can accept the long-term compatibility and privacy contract for an undocumented, profile-disclosing API.

options.title: Sponsor after live proof
options.body: Keep the draft until exact-head sender, receiver, and Messages.app liveness evidence validates the narrow force-send path, then adopt the public interfaces.

options.title: Narrow to inspection only
options.body: Retain read-only offer inspection but omit the profile-sharing mutation and its compatibility RPC method.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the feature until a documented or more stable sharing interface becomes available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft until exact-head sender, receiver, and Messages.app liveness evidence validates the narrow force-send path, then adopt the public interfaces.
